title: The 4 Best Adjustable Dumbbells Under $200
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for adjustable dumbbells under $200, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at adjustable dumbbells under $200 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Amazon Basics Adjustable Dumbbell Hand Weight Set, 38 lb with Case
products.blurb: Key specs: 38 lb total across two handles, Spin-lock collars, Portable storage case.
strengths: Cheapest genuine adjustable dumbbell option in this list
Storage case makes it portable and easy to tuck away
Highest review count of the two options here, a large track record at this price
limitations: Spin-lock collars are the slowest adjustment method in the category
19 lb max per hand at full build limits long-term progression

products.name: Amazon Basics 40-Pound Adjustable Weight Set with Case
products.blurb: Key specs: 40 lb total plate and collar set, Threaded collars, Carry case included.
strengths: Slightly more total weight than the 38 lb set for a similar price
Simple threaded-collar system with no mechanism to jam
Case keeps small plates and handles organized between sessions
limitations: Threaded collars are the slowest adjustment method in this list
Low total weight limits use mostly to light training and beginners
features: 40 lb total plate and collar set

products.name: Yes4All 40 lb Adjustable Cast Iron Dumbbell Set
strengths: Very affordable way to start lifting at home
limitations: Changing plates is slower than dial dumbbells

products.name: Yes4All 40 lb Adjustable Dumbbells with Connector
limitations: Bar length is short as a barbell
Not as compact as selectorized sets

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
